mapper.select: select min(lpn.global_order_index) from learning_path_nodes lpn join objectives o on lpn.objective_id = o.id join lessons l on o.lesson_id = l.id join topics t on l.topic_id = t.id where t.book_id = #{bookId}

select max(lpn.global_order_index) from learning_path_nodes lpn join objectives o on lpn.objective_id = o.id join lessons l on o.lesson_id = l.id join topics t on l.topic_id = t.id where t.book_id = #{bookId}

select b.* from speaking_questions sq join learning_path_nodes lpn on sq.id = lpn.speaking_question_id join objectives o on lpn.objective_id = o.id join lessons l on o.lesson_id = l.id join topics t on l.topic_id = t.id join books b on t.book_id = b.id where sq.id = #{speakingQuestionId}
